Local symbols: $\zeta_k$ is reaction extent per volume; $\mathbf b$ is the dimensionless linearized
residual; $\mathsf J$ its extent Jacobian; $\boldsymbol\lambda$ are constraint multipliers.
$e_n(T)$ is species specific internal energy. These are tracked in ISSUES.md.
### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Runs after the last stage when thermo reactions exist. `uv-solver` defaults to `auto`.
`kkt` selects the constrained solve; `partition` requires disjoint vapor-cloud reactions.
The fixed-energy constraint is @eq-ch02-saturation-energy; this is an operator-split solve.
:::

`uv_solver` defaults to `auto`, `max_iter` to 10 and `ftol` to $10^{-6}$ in
[`kintera thermo.hpp:80-87`](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/c55b13b2204997d2d09e04498558ab9495d8ee77/src/thermo/thermo.hpp#L80-L87).

### Derivation

A local phase change has no transport across the cell boundary. Integrating the energy equation over that
closed cell fixes $V_i\rho e$; with fixed volume this fixes internal energy density. Stoichiometric extents
change concentrations without changing conserved elemental totals. Write an extent $\zeta_k$ in
$\mathrm{mol\,m^{-3}}$ for each reaction:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\tilde c_n^{\mathrm{new}}&=\tilde c_n+\sum_k\nu_{nk}\zeta_k\ge0,\\
\rho e&=\sum_{n\in\{\mathrm d\}\cup\mathcal V\cup\mathcal C}
\mu_n\tilde c_n^{\mathrm{new}}e_n(T).
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch02-saturation-energy}

@eq-ch02-saturation-energy is implemented by `conc` in [`kintera equilibrate_uv.h:507-586`](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/c55b13b2204997d2d09e04498558ab9495d8ee77/src/thermo/equilibrate_uv.h#L507-L586).

For one vapor-cloud pair, a present cloud requires $S_n=1$; an absent cloud permits $S_n\le1$.
The general implementation compares the stoichiometrically weighted logarithm of gaseous reactant and product concentrations
with the fitted log saturation pressure minus the net gaseous stoichiometry sum times $\ln(\mathcal RT)$.
At constant energy, differentiating the energy constraint gives
$$
\mathrm dT=-\frac{\sum_n\mu_ne_n\,\mathrm d\tilde c_n}
{\sum_n\mu_n\tilde c_nc_{v,n}},
$$
where both sums include dry air. Substitute this into the differential of the log saturation residual.
The concentration derivative of each gaseous logarithm is $-\nu_{nk}/\tilde c_n$; the temperature derivative
adds the log-saturation derivative times the energy coefficient divided by volumetric heat capacity.
These are precisely the two contributions to `weight`. Multiplying this row by the active stoichiometry
forms `gain`.

The constrained least-squares step minimizes the squared linearized residual subject to
$\tilde{\mathbf c}+\mathsf N\boldsymbol\zeta\ge0$.
With local residual vector $\mathbf b$, Jacobian $\mathsf J$, and multipliers $\boldsymbol\lambda$, its
stationarity and complementarity conditions are
$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathsf J^\mathsf T(\mathsf J\boldsymbol\zeta-\mathbf b)-\mathsf N^\mathsf T\boldsymbol\lambda&=0,\\
\boldsymbol\lambda&\ge0,\\
\lambda_n(\tilde c_n+(\mathsf N\boldsymbol\zeta)_n)&=0.
\end{aligned}
$$
Both gaseous sides enter with their signed stoichiometry. A reaction with required gases absent on both
sides is deferred. The zero-extent point is feasible for nonnegative input concentrations. The source additionally limits each
reaction to available reactants, damps large gas-concentration changes, then Newton-solves the energy
constraint with a precision-aware tolerance and a bound of 100 temperature iterations.
The tolerance is the larger of $10^{-4}\,\mathrm K$ and $8\epsilon_{\mathrm m}|T|$. These safeguards mean a raw KKT solution is not the complete update.
`saturation_check.py` verifies mass conservation for a balanced reaction, fixed-energy temperature recovery,
and an interior constrained least-squares solution. It is not a replica of active-set selection or a proof
of global nonlinear convergence.

### Numerical method

`MeshBlockImpl` subtracts kinetic energy and passes interior density, internal energy and mass fractions
to `ThermoYImpl::forward`, with warm start enabled. Momentum and the total-energy row are not rewritten by
the phase solver. It rewrites species fractions; physical ghosts are refreshed afterward. Warm-start
reuse requires matching shape and device. Failures are counted from negative diagnostics; CPU warns
immediately, while device counters are consumed by the caller. The planned time-integration chapter and @sec-ch10 own rejection and rollback.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The energy kernel receives constant capacities and optional extra-energy function pointers. A matching
NASA-9/H2 phase closure is not established by the tensor EOS energy function. Negative input concentrations
are clamped with a warning, and nonpositive temperature fails. No full active-set convergence or multi-rank
phase-equilibrium run is supplied by this draft.
Switch-combination coverage remains pending in @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
